mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(customer_id AS CHAR) AS owner,CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR) AS warehouseId, snapshot_json AS snapshotJson,expires_at AS expiresAt,CAST(used_order_id AS CHAR) AS usedOrderId,created_at AS createdAt FROM checkout_quote WHERE customer_id = CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id = CAST(#{quoteId} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order(order_no,quote_id,customer_id,warehouse_id,state,address_snapshot_json,coupon_id,remark, gross_minor,discount_minor,shipping_minor,payable_minor,refunded_minor,expires_at,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{orderNo},CAST(#{quoteId} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{warehouseId} AS UNSIGNED),'UNPAID', #{addressSnapshotJson},NULL,#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},CAST(#{grossMinor} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{discountMinor} AS UNSIGNED), CAST(#{shippingMinor} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{payableMinor} AS UNSIGNED),0,#{expiresAt},0,#{createdAt},#{createdAt})

INSERT INTO sales_order_item(order_id,line_no,sku_id,product_id,product_name,specs_snapshot_json,image_snapshot_json, quantity,unit_price_minor,gross_minor,discount_minor,payable_minor,returned_quantity,refund_quantity_reserved,refunded_minor,version,created_at) VALUES(CAST(#{orderId} AS UNSIGNED),#{lineNo},CAST(#{skuId} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{productId} AS UNSIGNED),#{productName}, #{specsSnapshotJson},#{imageSnapshotJson},#{quantity},CAST(#{unitPriceMinor} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{grossMinor} AS UNSIGNED), CAST(#{discountMinor} AS UNSIGNED),CAST(#{payableMinor} AS UNSIGNED),0,0,0,0,#{createdAt})
